first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and the dataset-specific official CRS for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official SpatialNI Data Preparation Guide window materially changes method from Belfast distribution/API endpoints to the authoritative SpatialNI data-supply standard and confirms the accepted projection set Irish Grid TM65 (EPSG:29902), IG TM75 (EPSG:29903), and Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157). The guide is not Belfast-2006-specific, so none of these CRS values is promoted to the dataset CRS; no archive-internal tile filename, geometry or parcel binding is fabricated.
